feat(facts): Fact<T> and SessionFacts, the seam's type (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.cna) (#609)

* refactor(outcome): a failed outcome names the phase it failed in (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.cna)

failed(reason, failedAt) takes read | parse as a required argument, so every
producer states the phase it knows and the compiler finds the ones that did
not. The settings reader splits the two phases it used to throw as one.

* refactor(outcome): pending is a value recognised by its discriminator (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.cna)

PENDING, the identity-compared singleton, is gone. A pending reading is a plain
{kind, why} that survives JSON, and the owners' held form is flat: a Reading
whose pending arm also carries the landing a waiter awaits. A path walk stops
testing for pending inside a source's document, so a file that spells pending
is a value. One structural comparison decides a box write.

* feat(facts): Fact<T> and SessionFacts, the seam's type (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.cna)

A fact is a Reading with an instant on each answered arm; restamp is the one
place that instant is defined (the moment an answer first differed), so no owner
stores a time. SessionFacts is the spec's document over the value types the
owners already produce, and the compiler refuses any field JSON would corrupt:
the day sums are a record, and the git fact is the read before the PR is
composed onto it. parseFact is the one door a fact arrives by from outside.

* refactor(facts): fold failures keep their phase, Asked and the settings reader have one home (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.cna)
